Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-c.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check: are story 4, story 3, and task 19 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, the Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry?
What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and there’s nothing blocking you.

task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment that the reconciliation report is at risk, you’ll start it right after the idempotency keys, and you’ll flag it if it slips.

story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock this dependency on the idempotency keys so you can pick the summary page back up?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, is story 5 done, and is bug 12 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I'll add it to the parking lot; Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timing out and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted your blocker and commitment that the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review and you’ll chase them today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, is task 14 done, and is story 1 done?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the sandbox being down that caused the slip and your plan to finish it tomorrow, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Waiting on the sandbox from the platform team, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Recap: blockers were raised, including bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, PCI scan exceptions waiting on security review, and waiting on the sandbox from the platform team; one item reported as on track will resume after idempotency keys are in. We also parked an offline side discussion about gateway timeouts and configuration comparisons for Daniel Park and Admin. One flagged item was not covered: task 15 is stale, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including any that would apply for absent or non-responding attendees, are coming in Teams. Thank you, everyone.
